declarations.type:
∀ {identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity}
  {left right : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.CanonicalManifest identity},
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.universeRoot identity left =
      SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.universeRoot identity right →
    left.codes = right.codes
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.universe_root_binding

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity)
  (universeManifest frontierManifest : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.CanonicalManifest identity),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.universeRoot identity universeManifest ≠
    SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.frontierRoot identity frontierManifest
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.universe_and_frontier_roots_are_domain_separated

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity) (root : Nat)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate) (proof : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.CanonicalManifest identity),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteVerifyMembership identity root candidate proof = true →
    SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteContains identity root candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_membership_sound

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity) (root : Nat)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteContains identity root candidate →
    ∃ proof, SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteVerifyMembership identity root candidate proof = true
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_membership_complete

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity) (root : Nat)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteContains identity root candidate →
    SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteValidRoot identity root
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_contained_root_is_valid

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity) (root : Nat)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate) (proof : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.CanonicalManifest identity),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteVerifyExclusion identity root candidate proof = true →
    ¬SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteContains identity root candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_exclusion_sound

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity) (root : Nat)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate) (proof : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.CanonicalManifest identity),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteVerifyExclusion identity root candidate proof = true →
    SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteValidRoot identity root
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_exclusion_root_is_valid

declarations.type:
∀ (identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity) (root : Nat)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
  SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteValidRoot identity root →
    ¬SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteContains identity root candidate →
      ∃ proof, SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteVerifyExclusion identity root candidate proof = true
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_exclusion_complete

declarations.type:
∀ {identity : SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.IdealContentIdentity} {root : Nat}
  {candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  (membership :
    SearchRouteInspectCommittedUniverse.MembershipOpening
      (SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteCandidateCommitmentScheme identity) root candidate)
  (exclusion :
    SearchRouteInspectCommittedUniverse.ExclusionOpening
      (SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finiteCandidateCommitmentScheme identity) root candidate),
  False
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectFiniteCommitment.finite_verified_membership_and_exclusion_conflict
